0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 1-0 and 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Nuggets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, though Denver won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026. Denver will be without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is missing Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery).
